title: 토지개발 등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Methods of Registration)
(1) When a registrar cancels the registration concerning former land, the registrar shall record in the title section that the registration was made due to implementation of a land development project, mark the cancellation of entries in the title section, and thereafter close the registration record.
(2) When a registrar registers the preservation of ownership concerning newly developed land, the registrar shall record in the title section that registration was made due to implementation of a land development project.
(3) When a registrar makes registrations falling under Article 2 (2) 3 or 4 in the registration records of newly developed land, multiple such registrations shall be recorded in the order in which they were recorded in the registration records of the former land.
